name: Better Performance For Compare Judgments
description: Make compare judgments filters and pagination scale by introducing generation-based comparison serving marts, cursor reads, async counts, and serving-backed export.

userStories.title: Fix compare filter initialization
userStories.description: As a compare judgments user, I want URL filters to be preserved on first load so the page does not accidentally fetch a slower or incorrect filter.
acceptanceCriteria: The compare judgments page does not reset `differenceFilter` until metadata columns are loaded.
The judgments query does not run until metadata confirms the selected difference filter is valid.
A route or helper test covers initial load with `differenceFilter=human-vs-llm` and preserves that filter.

userStories.title: Add comparison serving schema
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want DuckDB serving tables for comparison projects so filtered comparison rows can be materialized and read efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: The article serving table stores article metadata, row sort fields, answered counts, row-filter flags, difference-filter flags, and conflict flags.

The cell serving table stores comparison project id, generation, article id, column id, column order, kind, prompt id, model id, source project id, content key, display answer, normalized answers, and source timestamps.
The filter member table stores comparison project id, generation, row filter, difference filter, article id, ordinal, article created at, and article title.
The stats table stores comparison project id, generation, row filter, difference filter, total count, and stats updated timestamp.
Indexes support active generation reads, filter membership reads, cell lookups, and stats lookups.

userStories.title: Add serving generation helpers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want reusable helpers for comparison serving generations so rebuilds can stage data and atomically promote a complete generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add server helpers to read the active comparison serving generation for a comparison project.
Add server helpers to create a new inactive generation for a comparison project.
Add server helpers to promote a staged generation atomically after a successful rebuild.
Add cleanup helpers that remove old generations without deleting the active generation.
Failed rebuild helper paths preserve the last active generation.
Unit tests cover missing generation, staged generation, promotion, cleanup, and failed rebuild preservation.

userStories.title: Materialize prompt-mode comparison cells
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want prompt-mode comparison cells built in SQL so LLM and human prompt answers are stored once per serving generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a set-based SQL builder for prompt-mode LLM comparison cells using configured prompts, models, content variants, and source project scope.
Add a set-based SQL builder for prompt-mode human comparison cells using the latest answered human prompt judgments.
Cell `column_id` values match the existing `getComparisonProjectColumnId` conventions.
Cell `display_answer` and `normalized_answers` preserve current answer normalization semantics.
Tests compare prompt-mode serving cells against current TypeScript row assembly for representative LLM, human, array-answer, and missing-answer cases.

userStories.title: Materialize summary-mode comparison cells
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want summary-mode comparison cells built in SQL so derived LLM summary answers and human summary answers are materialized consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a set-based SQL builder for summary-mode LLM cells using source project summary prompt groups.
Summary-mode LLM derivation matches current `deriveStrictSummaryAnswer` behavior for include and exclude criteria.
Add a set-based SQL builder for summary-mode human cells using normalized human summary answers.
Summary-mode cell `column_id` values match the existing summary column conventions.
Tests cover yes, no, maybe, missing criteria metadata, missing prompt answers, source project grouping, and human summary normalization.

userStories.title: Build comparison rollups and filters
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want article rollups, filter memberships, and filter stats generated from materialized cells so every compare filter is fast.
acceptanceCriteria: Build `mart.comparison_article_serving` rows from materialized cells and scoped article metadata.
Compute `has_human_vs_llm_difference`, `has_llm_vs_llm_difference`, `has_any_disagreement`, and `has_conflict` in SQL with existing filter semantics.
Build `mart.comparison_filter_member` rows for all supported row-filter and difference-filter combinations.
Filter member ordinals are stable for `article_created_at DESC`, `article_title ASC`, and `article_id ASC` ordering.
Serving builder tests cover prompt mode, summary mode, all row filters, all difference filters, and page/export parity fixtures.

userStories.title: Execute comparison serving rebuilds
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a rebuild service that stages, builds, promotes, and cleans comparison serving generations so reads remain stable during rebuilds.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a comparison serving rebuild service that creates a staged generation, builds cells, builds rollups, builds filter members, builds stats, promotes the generation, and cleans old generations.
The rebuild service runs all multi-table changes in safe transactions where practical.
Failed rebuilds record an error state and do not replace the active generation.
A successful rebuild updates serving status fields for metadata reads.
Tests cover successful rebuild, failed rebuild, stale active generation preservation, and old generation cleanup.

userStories.title: Expose serving status and create-edit rebuilds
userStories.description: As a compare judgments user, I want comparison metadata to show whether fast serving data is ready so the page can avoid silent slow scans.
acceptanceCriteria: Comparison project create requests queue or run an initial comparison serving rebuild.
Comparison project edit requests mark serving stale and queue or run a rebuild.
The metadata endpoint returns a clear materializing or stale state when no active serving generation exists.
Route tests cover metadata status fields for ready, missing, stale, refreshing, and failed serving states.

userStories.title: Invalidate serving on source changes
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want comparison serving data marked stale when dependent LLM or human judgments change so fast reads do not show obsolete comparisons indefinitely.
acceptanceCriteria: LLM judgment changes mark affected comparison projects stale when model, prompt, content settings, and source project scope overlap.
Human prompt judgment changes mark affected prompt-mode comparison projects stale.
Human summary judgment changes mark affected summary-mode comparison projects stale.
Conflict resolution changes do not trigger a serving rebuild because conflict resolution is joined at read time.
Tests cover LLM dependency matching, prompt human dependency matching, summary human dependency matching, and conflict resolution exclusion.

userStories.title: Read judgments with cursor serving path
userStories.description: As a compare judgments user, I want the judgments endpoint to return a page of rows from serving data so any filter loads quickly regardless of total matching rows.
acceptanceCriteria: The endpoint resolves the active serving generation and reads matching article ids from `mart.comparison_filter_member` by cursor and limit.
The endpoint joins article metadata from `mart.comparison_article_serving` only for returned article ids.
The endpoint joins cells from `mart.comparison_cell_serving` only for returned article ids.
The endpoint joins conflict resolutions only for returned article ids.
The endpoint returns `nextCursor`, `totalCount: null`, `totalPages: null`, and serving status without blocking on exact counts.
Route tests cover cursor pagination, every row filter, every difference filter, missing active generation, and conflict resolution hydration.

userStories.title: Add comparison judgments count endpoint
userStories.description: As a compare judgments user, I want exact counts to load separately so the table can render before totals are available.
acceptanceCriteria: The count endpoint reads `total_count` from `mart.comparison_filter_stats` for the active generation.
The count endpoint returns `totalCount`, `totalPages`, and serving status.
The count endpoint does not scan comparison cells or rebuild row filters on request.
Route tests cover every row filter, every difference filter, missing stats, and missing active generation.

userStories.title: Convert compare UI to load-more pagination
userStories.description: As a compare judgments user, I want rows to load with cursor pagination and counts to appear asynchronously so large filters stay responsive.
acceptanceCriteria: The compare judgments page uses cursor/load-more pagination instead of exact page navigation for row data.
The page fetches rows first and fetches exact counts separately from the count endpoint.
The page shows a count skeleton or pending state while exact counts load.
The page preserves row filter, difference filter, and limit state in the URL.
The page shows materializing, stale, or failed serving status when metadata reports it.
Browser verification confirms `differenceFilter=human-vs-llm` is preserved, rows load before count, and load-more works.

userStories.title: Stream compare export from serving marts
userStories.description: As a compare judgments user, I want exports to use the same fast filter membership as the page so exporting large filtered comparisons does not recompute all rows.
acceptanceCriteria: The compare export endpoint iterates `mart.comparison_filter_member` in ordinal batches for the selected row and difference filters.
The export joins article rows and cells per batch from comparison serving tables.
The export preserves page filter semantics for all row filters and difference filters.
The export does not call the old TypeScript full-scan row builder during normal serving-ready operation.
Export/page parity tests cover every row filter and difference filter.

userStories.title: Remove normal slow fallback
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want normal compare reads to avoid unbounded request-time scans so missing serving data is surfaced as a materializing state instead of hidden latency.
acceptanceCriteria: Normal judgments page reads do not use the TypeScript full-scan row builder when no active generation exists.
The API returns a clear materializing or stale status when serving data is not ready.
The UI handles the not-ready status without showing an empty successful table.
Any remaining fallback is explicitly bounded to small local development cases or tests.
Regression tests verify missing serving data does not trigger unbounded article scanning.
Browser verification confirms the compare page shows a clear materializing or stale state when serving data is unavailable.
